voidsworn.d: Next battle, ships next to an ally take 15% less hull damage.
voidsworn.freeD: free after an offering at a wall of names

hegemony.d: Next battle, synchronized fire reaches 4 hexes from the flagship and its bonus rises to +20%.
hegemony.freeD: free once a defector has briefed you

corsair.d: Gain 30 credits, plus 10 for every greedy choice this run. The Nemesis clock moves on.

chorus.d: Consume a refit from the hold: every ship regrows 20% of its hull (30% if the fleet has fed at a spawning field).

ithar.d: Next battle, every shield is 25% stronger.
ithar.freeD: free once you have answered the tone

deathless.d: Next battle, Archive restore brings back one more ship.
deathless.freeD: free once a dormant yard has woken a hull for you
